card.name: Colon in epinephrine 1:1000 ratio
card.fires_on: The colon in the ratio 1:1000, mostly in epinephrine dosing text for airway obstruction. It also fires weakly on the separator just before a thousands group in large numbers.

modes.label: Epinephrine ratio colon
modes.description: The colon between 1 and 1000 in an epinephrine concentration.

modes.label: Thousands separator
modes.description: A space or comma just before the 000 group in a large number.
modes.example: Discontinue CIBINQO and follow with CBC until >100<<,>>000/mm 3 ALC
